cases.case_label: IVS16ins3kb processed C6orf68 cDNA insertion in SLC25A13 intron 16
cases.disease: Citrin deficiency (adult-onset type II citrullinemia, CTLN2)
cases.mechanism_detail: A 2,667-nt insertion in SLC25A13 intron 16 consisting of an antisense processed cDNA copy of C6orf68, flanked by a 17-nt duplication; the abstract does not describe its transcript effect. Seen in 22 Japanese families and in all East Asian populations tested.
cases.quote: IVS16ins3kb identified in a Japanese CTLN2 family seems to be a retrotransposal insertion, as the inserted sequence (2,667-nt) showed an antisense strand of processed complementary DNA (cDNA) from a gene on chromosome 6 (C6orf68)
